commitments.detail: Repay $10,000,000 of the term loan secured by the distribution center.
Lease the distribution center back for five years at an annual base rent of $4,000,000.
Ensure the sale price of $20,000,000 reflects current market value.
Manage the impact on the company's financial covenants post-sale.
Set aside $500,000 as a reserve for potential tax implications.
